lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is broader in the mid-torso region and becomes progressively narrower towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The four most anterior lines and the three most posterior lines terminate mid-flank, exhibiting clear discontinuities before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 6-8 white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower posterior haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two white spots on the lower cheek, a white chevron marking between the eyes, and a single white transverse band at the base of the neck.
